title: expect_sse_stream_end fails on a keep-alive frame after about 15 s instead of reporting a hang
outcome: A stream that doesn't end is reported as a stream that didn't end, at the helper's limit, not as an unexpected keep-alive chunk at 15 s.
acceptance: expect_sse_stream_end skips comment-only keep-alive frames, and a recorded failing run shows a stream that never ends reporting the helper's own message
